# Testing Agent

## Purpose
This agent assists with testing and quality assurance for the Mangadexter project, helping with test creation, execution, and quality assurance practices.

## Key Capabilities
- Creating unit tests for F# modules using xUnit
- Working with test infrastructure and test project structure
- Implementing test patterns for F# code (pure functions, Result-based error handling)
- Running and debugging tests in the .NET environment
- Working with test coverage and code quality metrics
- Migrating manual test scripts to proper test cases

## How it assists with Mangadexter
The Testing Agent helps with:
1. Creating new unit tests for core modules (Data, Manga, File)
2. Implementing test cases for Result-based error handling
3. Working with the existing xUnit test infrastructure
4. Running tests locally and in CI/CD pipeline
5. Maintaining test coverage for core logic
6. Migrating manual .fsx test scripts to proper unit tests

## Examples of when it would be useful
- Adding new test cases for existing functionality
- Creating tests for new features or modules
- Improving test coverage for existing code
- Debugging failing tests or test infrastructure issues
- Implementing new testing patterns or practices
- Working with CI/CD test workflows
